command: import json,os; from pathlib import Path; cg=Path("/proc/self/cgroup").read_text().strip().split("::",1)[1]; base=Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")/cg.lstrip("/"); print(json.dumps({"pid":os.getpid(),"cgroup":cg,"controls":{name:(base/name).read_text().strip() if (base/name).exists() else "MISSING" for name in ["cpu.max","memory.max","memory.swap.max","cgroup.controllers"]},"parent_cgroup":Path(f"/proc/{os.getppid()}/cgroup").read_text().strip()}))
